tasks.title: The Torn Message
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #1: Crime Scene Jigsaw
tasks.description: Twelve pieces of a torn photo/document were recovered from the bank crime scene. Reconstruct the 12 jigsaw pieces to reveal the key word.

tasks.title: The Encoded Word
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #2: Encoded Key Stream
tasks.description: The keyword from the torn message leads to a second piece of evidence containing an encoded message. Identify the encoding to reveal the flag.

tasks.title: The Decoded Text
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #3: Visit /K7mQ-4vNp-X2
tasks.description: The decoded key from Task 2 directs you to open page /K7mQ-4vNp-X2. Open the page and inspect its HTML source code to uncover the hidden clue.

tasks.title: The Hidden Archive
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #4: Web Discovery & robots.txt
tasks.description: The HTML clue leads to a hidden location. Inspect /robots.txt to discover the disallow directory hiding the bank's auxiliary vault evidence.

tasks.title: The Bank Statement
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #5: Obfuscated Transaction Log
tasks.description: Inside the auxiliary vault, an intercepted transaction payload has been multi-encoded to conceal the key stream. Analyze and reverse the transformation layers to extract the Task 5 flag.

tasks.title: The Security Camera
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #6: Image Timestamp Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze security photo image.jpg recovered from the bank security system. Download image.jpg and find the exact time the photo was taken (HH:MM:SS).

tasks.title: The Bank's Login System
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #7: Authentication Logic Analysis
tasks.description: The robbers managed to access the bank's internal system. Access /login and inspect the HTTP request/response flow using Chrome/Edge DevTools (Network tab) to discover how the authentication logic was bypassed.

tasks.title: The Visitor That Never Existed
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #8: Campus Visitor Logic Analysis
tasks.description: Investigate transaction logs showing visitor COLLEGE-WEB at 03:17:42. Open /college, check visitor VST-4821, analyze request transformations, and locate archive ARCH-27 to restore the record and recover the Task 8 flag.

tasks.title: The Vanishing Employee
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #9: Browser Storage & State Transition
tasks.description: Investigate missing employee EMP-4817 at /employees. Analyze browser Local Storage state transitions (directory_mode = archive) and execute recovery code R4-91-X to restore the record and extract the Task 9 flag.

tasks.title: The Robbers' Vault Core
tasks.subtitle: Evidence #10: Multi-Layer Cryptographic & Forensic Analysis
tasks.description: Reconstruct the 10-stage cyber investigation. Triangulate primary evidence parameters (Task 5 TX ID, Task 8 Transfer/Archive ID, Task 9 Case Ref), perform double-Base64 decoding, XOR key stream extraction, and Master Access Code override to unlock BLACK_BOX_10.
